scene: During window-cleaning day after a storm, patio side of closed sliding glass door seen obliquely so both dogs’ full bodies show. Buddy has stolen a damp cleaning rag and holds one end softly in his mouth, pressing the dangling cloth against the lower glass; a broad untidy drool smear marks his attempt to polish. He stands on all four paws, neck reaching forward naturally, no human hands replacing paws. Neet stands nearby inspecting TWO small muddy pawprints he has just left on an adjacent pane, head angled toward Buddy’s worse smear with grave disbelief. Glass shows soft indoor room beyond and a few rain droplets, patio damp. An indoor cropped hand holding a microfiber cloth can be faintly visible beyond glass but no human face. No active pressure-water jet contacting dogs. Joke: both proudly undo cleaning. No captions, symbols or invented equipment.
alt_text: Buddy polishes with a stolen rag while Neet inspects the marks they are leaving on the clean glass.
